run_nsp_retraining_job: run the NSP retraining job to download new data, train a model, and upload the best model to S3
run_nsp_new_data_listener: run the NSP new data listener to watch S3 for new annotated data and trigger retraining
create_mask_for_data_splits: create train valid and test boolean masks combining old and new NSP data for model training
download_nsp_data_from_s3: download NSP annotated data and meta files from S3 and preprocess into the expected format
copy_best_model_from_logs: parse training log files to find the best accuracy model and copy it as best_model.pth
